title: What is Your Decision-Making Style?
subtitle: Discover how your mind processes risks, choices, and tradeoffs under real-world pressure.

questions.text: When you have to make a critical choice with limited time, what is your go-to move?

options.text: Gather as much concrete data as possible before pulling the trigger.
Trust my immediate gut instinct; it rarely steers me wrong.
Consult trusted mentors or team members for their input.
Make a quick call to test in reality and iterate along the way.

questions.text: What makes you most uncomfortable during decision-making?

options.text: A total lack of verifiable metrics or clear evidence.
Having to over-explain a hunch I already know is right.
Knowing a key stakeholder is strongly against the plan.
Endless bureaucracy, meetings, and indecision.

questions.text: What is your typical posture during high-stakes strategic meetings?

options.text: Stress-test assumptions and request hard facts.
Propose bold, out-of-the-box directions others overlooked.
Synthesize differing viewpoints into common ground.
Push for actionable next steps and strict deadlines.

questions.text: How do you evaluate whether a past decision was truly a success?

options.text: By the measurable ROI and performance metrics.
By the clarity of purpose and long-term impact created.
By team satisfaction and alignment across stakeholders.
By execution speed and the tangible milestones conquered.

questions.text: If you could unlock one professional superpower, which would it be?

options.text: The power to forecast probabilistic outcomes with mathematical certainty.
Visionary foresight to spot paradigm shifts years before the crowd.
A magnetic ability to unite any group toward a shared mission.
Infinite momentum to turn ideas into reality without friction.

rational.title: The Strategic Analyst
rational.description: You decide based on logic, data, and risk calculation. Your mind carefully maps variables before acting, ensuring bulletproof execution and high precision.

intuitive.title: The Intuitive Visionary
intuitive.description: You spot subtle patterns and connect dots others overlook. You don't need endless spreadsheets to know when a bold opportunity holds transformative potential.

collaborative.title: The Consensus Builder
collaborative.description: You believe durable decisions require collective ownership. Your leadership cultivates deep loyalty, mutual trust, and unstoppable team cohesion.

action.title: The Agile Executor
action.description: For you, 'done is better than perfect'. You'd rather fail fast and adapt than suffer analysis paralysis. Your bias for action drives monumental momentum.
